SELECT s.store_id, o.status, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS d_lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(f.gross_amount) g, min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dmin, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dmax
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date, f.sales_line_id, f.gross_amount, p.category, s.store_id, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_lines,
  sum(gross_amount) gross_all, sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) test_gross,
  sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) gross_ex_test
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.dispatch_date
WHERE l.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-11-05'

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.vat_rate
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2024-07-25' AND dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2024-10-30')
)
SELECT store_id, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad_vat,
  min(vat_rate) mnv, max(vat_rate) mxv, sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount<=0 OR net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM l GROUP BY 1

WITH ol AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.order_total_gross, o.line_count, o.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd,
    sum(f.gross_amount) g, count(f.sales_line_id) n
  FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
  WHERE o.dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2024-07-25' AND o.dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2024-10-30'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT status, count(*) orders, sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(g,0)-order_total_gross)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN n<>line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) count_mismatch, sum(order_total_gross) tot, sum(g) lines_g
FROM ol GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, (f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01') AS on_or_after_sep1, count(*) n, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-11-05'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3,2

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) net_mine
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wd.dd
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND wd.dd BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
  GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) net_ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id=900 AND r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, net_mine, net_ctl, net_mine-net_ctl diff FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
